independent_computation.question: Within a Syndra rotation, what is the correct sourced justification for a second Q ('Q2') entry?
steps: Step 1 - enumerate Syndra's abilities from the cached wiki parse (data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities). Names: P Transcendent, Q Dark Sphere, W Force of Will, E Scatter the Weak, R Unleashed Power.

Step 2 - search each ability's effect text for the word 'recast'. Exactly one ability contains it: W Force of Will ('Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held.' and a dedicated 'Recast:' effect). Q, E, R and the passive contain no recast text. Therefore Syndra's Q has no recast mechanic; the recast in her kit belongs to W.

Step 3 - determine what actually produces a second Q. Q Dark Sphere effect[1] is a Transcendent Bonus: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' Q also carries rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7] (a charge/ammo recharge field), and its cooldown block is 7s flat with affectedByCdr = false. This is an ammo/charge system gated at 40 Splinters of Wrath with a cap of 2 charges - not a recast of a single cast instance.

Step 4 - check the passive's stack economy for the gate's plausibility. P Transcendent: Splinters of Wrath stack up to 120, with per-ability thresholds. Observed thresholds in the cached text: Q at 40 (second Dark Sphere charge), W at 60 (bonus true damage), E at 80 (scatter angle + 70% slow), R at 100 (execute below 15% max HP), and 120 for Transcendence (+15% AP). The 40 figure in the old value matches the Q threshold exactly.

Step 5 - check the repo's own vocabulary for 'recast'. docs/math-foundations.md Section 1.1 uses 'recast' in the scheduling sense: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline ... an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress'. Under that in-repo meaning, 'Q2 recast_of Q' reads as 'Q2 is a second cast of Q on the shared timeline', which is true for a charge-stocked second Q. Under the game-mechanics meaning asserted by the new value ('Q2 is Q's recast'), the claim is false - Syndra's Q is not a recastable ability.

Step 6 - compare the two candidate strings as *source* citations. The old value cites a verifiable, correct mechanism ('40+ splinter second charge') that both explains why a second Q exists and records its precondition (>= 40 Splinters of Wrath). The new value is circular ('Q2 is the recast of Q - Q2 is Q's recast'), cites no cached evidence, drops the 40-Splinter precondition (so a Q2 would be admissible at 0 Splinters, which the wiki forbids), and asserts a recast relation that the cached wiki text contradicts.
independent_computation.computed_correct_value: Q2 is Syndra's second stocked Dark Sphere charge, unlocked by the Q Transcendent Bonus at 40 Splinters of Wrath (charge cap 2, 7s recharge) - i.e. a second cast of Q from charges, NOT a recast of Q. Syndra's only recastable ability is W Force of Will. The old leaf text captures this ('40+ splinter second charge'); the new leaf text does not.
independent_computation.arithmetic: No numeric computation is required for this leaf; it is a provenance/justification string. The only quantities involved are read verbatim from cached wiki text: Splinter threshold = 40, Dark Sphere charge cap = 2, Q recharge = 7s at all ranks, Q base damage 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) - none of which the new value contradicts or preserves.

reasoning_summary: Syndra's Q Dark Sphere has no recast; the only recast in her kit is W Force of Will. A second Q in a rotation exists because the Q Transcendent Bonus stocks a Dark Sphere charge (cap 2) once 40 Splinters of Wrath are collected. The old leaf states exactly that mechanism and its 40-Splinter precondition, and its 'recast_of' term is consistent with the repo's own scheduling vocabulary in docs/math-foundations.md ('an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed'). The new leaf is circular, cites no cached evidence, discards the 40-Splinter precondition, and re-reads 'recast_of' in the game-mechanics sense, producing a claim ('Q2 is Q's recast') that the cached wiki text directly contradicts.
caveats: The 'recast_of atom' vocabulary referenced by the new value does not exist anywhere in the exported evidence tree (data/atoms/atoms.schema.json enumerates families damage/heal/shield/crowd_control/stack/transform/summon/execute/resource/movement/vision/buff/debuff/interaction/economy; data/wiki-atoms/atom-relations.json contains no recast relation). If 'recast_of' is a code-side relation whose defined meaning is strictly 'second cast of the same ability on the shared timeline', then the relation label itself is defensible in both strings - but the new value's added gloss 'Q2 is Q's recast' is still false for Syndra, and the loss of the 40-Splinter precondition is a real loss of sourced information.
Adjudication is on the sourcing/semantics of a provenance string, not on a damage number; no golden numeric value is implicated by this leaf.
